groceries.line: A word about Gnosis: it ain't gonna buy the groceries
stanza: Oh, the old modus: out to be leading live
Said, comes the old ponens, demit to strive
A word about Gnosis: it ain't gonna buy the groceries
Or middle-out locusts, or weigh to find

groceries.line: "I'm a pretty good cook, I'm sittin' on my groceries
stanza: "I'm a pretty good cook, I'm sittin' on my groceries
Come up to my kitchen, I'll show you my best recipe
I try and I try but I can't save a cent
I'm up after midnight cookin', tryna make my rent
I'm rough but I'm pleasin', I was raised on robbery"
